title: Eraser tool shows a rectangular selection-style marquee during drag instead of just the eraser disk cursor
description:
FIXED. Root cause: StageArea.tsx eraser mouse-MOVE handler set a spurious eraserPreview = bounding-rect of the whole drag path on every move, rendered as an orange dashed (#ff6600) translucent rect overlay — a leftover, NOT a selection-marquee fallthrough. Fix (StageArea.tsx, src-only, +1/-27): removed the eraserPreview useState, all 3 setEraserPreview calls (down/move/up), the dead minX/minY/maxX/maxY bbox computation, the deps-array entry, and the dashed-rect overlay div. Preserved: const half=eraserSize/2 (load-bearing for the erase radius), the round disk-cursor overlay (borderRadius:50%), the cursor:none mapping, and the real-time planar/legacy vector erase path.

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => Done (7 pkgs). authoring-ui unit tests => 78 files / 1022 passed / 0 failed. NEW e2e apps/desktop/e2e/eraser-cursor-1333.spec.ts (drag eraser; assert mid-drag NO dashed-orange marquee div AND round disk cursor present; none lingers post-release) => 1 passed. Sanity-checked: re-injecting the buggy marquee made the test FAIL (0 vs 1), then reverted. Disjoint from concurrent 1332 (engine/planar/eraser.ts core).
